mermaid:
flowchart TD
  subgraph CFG["Configuration"]
    CF["_config.yml"]
  end
  subgraph LAY["Gabarits Jekyll"]
    DEF["_layouts/default.html"]
    PG["_layouts/page.html"]
    PO["_layouts/post.html"]
    HEAD["_includes/head.html"]
    SB["_includes/sidebar.html"]
  end
  subgraph CNT["Contenu et styles"]
    IDX["index.html"]
    POST["_posts/2013-12-28-introducing-hyde.md"]
    ABT["about.md"]
    POOLE["public/css/poole.css"]
    HYDE["public/css/hyde.css"]
  end
  CF --> DEF
  DEF --> HEAD
  DEF --> SB
  PG --> DEF
  PO --> DEF
  IDX --> DEF
  POST --> PO
  ABT --> PG
  HEAD --> POOLE
  HEAD --> HYDE
explication: Hyde est un thème Jekyll : toutes les pages passent par _layouts/default.html, qui inclut head.html (feuilles de style poole et hyde) et sidebar.html. Les articles utilisent post.html et les pages statiques page.html.
source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: Hyde is a Jekyll theme: every page goes through _layouts/default.html, which includes head.html (poole and hyde stylesheets) and sidebar.html. Posts use post.html and static pages use page.html.
